minepapers.gui.title: Picture Settings
minepapers.gui.path.0.tip:
File or subfolder inside config/minepapers.
The < > buttons cycle through what is there.
minepapers.gui.path.1.tip:
Public Yandex Disk folder link (Ctrl+V to paste).
Pictures from the folder change in random order.
minepapers.gui.path.2.tip: Full path to a folder with pictures (Ctrl+V to paste).
minepapers.gui.path.3.tip:
Direct link to a picture (http/https, Ctrl+V to paste).
The link must point to the image file itself, not to a page with it.
minepapers.gui.frameShape.0.tip:
The picture has no frame.
The frame block returns to you when the window closes.
minepapers.gui.frameShape.1.tip:
The frame covers only the canvas edges,
the whole picture stays open.
Without a canvas, turns on the block canvas.
minepapers.gui.frameShape.2.tip:
Frame width in pixels: a real frame covers
the edge of the picture and sticks out above it.
0 - no molding.
minepapers.gui.canvasKind.0.tip:
The picture is painted right on the wall.
A PNG with transparent background looks like a decal.
The canvas block returns to you when the window closes.
minepapers.gui.canvasKind.1.tip:
The picture sits on a 1-pixel thick canvas
made of the block in the slot.
minepapers.gui.canvasKind.2.tip:
The picture is its own canvas, 1 pixel thick.
The edges stretch the picture's outer pixels.
The canvas block returns to you when the window closes.
minepapers.gui.materials.stack: On this server materials can be changed only for a single picture, not for a stack.
minepapers.gui.shift.x: Offset to the right of the clicked block
minepapers.gui.shift.y: Offset up from the clicked block
minepapers.gui.padding.tip: Gap between the image and the canvas edges, on all sides
minepapers.gui.zoom.tip:
Makes the image bigger (positive) or smaller (negative)
on each side. What goes past the padding is cropped.
minepapers.gui.lock.tip:
Only you will be able to change this picture.
Others will see only its title and description.
minepapers.gui.sign.tip:
Your nickname stays on the picture forever.
It shows when you look at the picture holding Shift.
Only an unlocked picture can be signed.
minepapers.gui.sign.confirm.text: Your nickname %s will stay on the picture forever. This cannot be undone.
minepapers.gui.sign.onClose: The signature is set when the window closes.
minepapers.gui.sign.stack:
Only a single picture can be signed, not a stack.
A signature is unique.
minepapers.gui.pixels.tip:
Checked - values are in pixels (1/16 block).
Unchecked - in blocks.
The picture size is also its hitbox.
minepapers.gui.fit.0.tip:
fill: the picture is stretched over the whole canvas.
Aspect ratio is not kept.
minepapers.gui.fit.1.tip:
contain: the whole picture fits into the canvas
keeping its aspect ratio; empty margins remain.
minepapers.gui.fit.2.tip:
cover: the picture covers the whole canvas
keeping its aspect ratio; overflow is cropped.
minepapers.gui.fit.3.tip:
none: original size - 1 picture pixel per
1 style pixel, centered, overflow is cropped.
minepapers.gui.fit.4.tip:
scale-down: like none, but if the picture does not fit
it is shrunk like contain.
minepapers.gui.sharp.tip:
No semi-transparency: a pixel is either fully visible
or fully transparent, like on maps.
The edges of a picture with a transparent background
stay crisp instead of blending into the wall.
minepapers.gui.mapPalette.tip:
Only the colors Minecraft maps can show,
like real map art. The palette sets the colors itself,
dithering mixes them for smooth gradients.
minepapers.gui.nsfw.tip:
Mark the picture as not safe for work.
Players with "hideNsfw": true in config/minepapers.json
see an empty canvas instead of it.
minepapers.gui.nsfw.on:
The picture is marked as NSFW.
Click to remove the mark.
minepapers.gui.colors.tip:
Posterization: how many shades each color channel
(red, green, blue) keeps.
25 is closest to the original colors.
minepapers.gui.ditherMode.0.tip:
Floyd-Steinberg: the color error spreads to neighboring pixels.
Smooth gradients, but the dots look random.
minepapers.gui.ditherMode.1.tip:
Ordered (Bayer 4x4): the dots form a regular square grid,
like in old games.
minepapers.gui.dither.tip:
Mixes the colors with dots for smooth gradients.
0%% - flat areas of color, 100%% - full dithering.
minepapers.gui.ppb.tip:
Picture resolution in pixels per block.
128 - like a map in a frame, 16 - like a vanilla painting.
Lower - bigger pixels and lighter for the game.
minepapers.gui.status.unknown: Press Reload or close the window to load
minepapers.tooltip.glow.self: Glows by itself, no light around
minepapers.error.notFound: file, folder or link not found
minepapers.error.noImages: no pictures found (png, jpg, jfif, gif, bmp, webp)
minepapers.error.notAbsolute: a full path is required, e.g. C:\Pictures
minepapers.error.badUrl: the link must start with http:// or https://
minepapers.error.notImage: the link is not a picture (png, jpg, gif, bmp, webp are supported)
minepapers.gui.status.preparing: Preparing pictures for the server: %d of %d
minepapers.gui.status.uploading: Uploading pictures to the server: %d of %d
minepapers.gui.copy.tip:
All picture settings, materials included, go to the clipboard (JSON).
You can edit it in any text editor.
minepapers.gui.paste.tip:
Apply settings from the clipboard.
Blocks for the frame, canvas and glow are taken from your inventory.
minepapers.chat.copied: Picture settings copied to the clipboard
minepapers.chat.badConfig: The clipboard has no picture settings
minepapers.chat.missing: Missing in your inventory for the picture: %s
